n1.text:
3D · HERO CONTAINER FIELD

9×4×4 wireframe cubes (the grader containers) on a floor grid. One draw call: merged edge geometry + custom line shader. Cursor → nearby cubes spin faster, scale up and glow phosphor. Signal pulses travel the rows like requests through the gateway.

On scroll the camera tilts down 25° and the field sinks under the About section, fading to the faint floor grid that persists behind the whole page (parallax 0.15).

DPR capped at 1.5 on phones, 2 on desktop. Static poster + no WebGL when prefers-reduced-motion is on or WebGL is unavailable.

n2.text:
MOTION CHOREOGRAPHY

0. Boot: 6 terminal lines type in (~1.2s), progress bar fills, then a CRT power-on flash reveals the hero. Skippable with any key. Shown once per session.

1. Hero: name letters decode (random glyphs → final) 60ms stagger; tagline types; cursor blinks.

2. Every section header: the `$ command` types when it enters the viewport, then content reveals 24px up, 80ms stagger.

3. Experience: the git graph line draws itself on scroll; commit nodes pop at each entry.

4. Projects: cards tilt in 3D with the cursor (max 6°) with a glare highlight; schematics pulse on hover; test counters count up in view.

5. Skills: a scan line sweeps the group as chips appear.

6. Contact: email click copies, shows `copied ✓` for 1.6s. Footer ends on `exit 0`.

Custom cursor: dot + ring, ring expands on links; buttons are magnetic within 60px.

n3.text:
ACCESSIBILITY · PERF

• All text ≥ 4.5:1 on ink. Muted #8FA39A is 7.5:1.
• Real <a> / <button>; focus rings in phosphor.
• prefers-reduced-motion: no boot, no 3D, no typing; everything visible immediately.
• 3D lazy-loaded after first paint; scene paused when hero is off-screen.
• Phone number is NOT published; email only.
• `~` key opens a mini terminal (help, ls, cat about, open github, theme amber).

n4.text: SUPERSEDED — 23 Oct 2026. These boards are the first, terminal-themed version, which Mahir rejected. The built site is now a full 3D showpiece: deep indigo + electric violet + acid lime, Unbounded display type, an iridescent crystal floating in front of a giant 3D name, scroll-driven camera scenes, bloom and grain. See src/world in the repo; this canvas is kept for reference only.
